# Class: `InptkPreferencesWidget`

Lets users choose and test a separately installed toolkit executable.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-panel.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_panel.py#L75) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QWidget`.

Keeps the path in a line edit and uses InptkClient to test the connection. Displays the reported toolkit version and stops the test process after a successful connection.
